abstract: OBJECTIVES: To determine the value of frozen section examination for the management of small incidental testis tumors. METHODS: We reviewed all cases of incidental nonpalpable testis tumors that have been examined in frozen section during the period 1996-2002. For each case, frozen section and definitive histological slides were available and were reviewed. RESULTS: Fifteen cases were retrieved in the files of the Department of Pathology. Nine cases were discovered by ultrasonography examination in patients presenting with infertility. Six cases were discovered incidentally by sonography for testis trauma or scrotal pain. The patients were aged from 18 to 43 years. The tumors measured from 4 to 16 mm. Frozen section examination concluded in 9 cases to a benign lesion "Leydig cell nodule", in four cases a diagnosis of malignancy was retained and the last two cases were inconclusive. The standard microscopic examination confirmed the 9 cases of Leydig cell tumors; malignancy was confirmed in the 4 cases (3 seminomas and one teratoma) and the uncertain cases were benign Sertoli cells tumors. Benign lesions were treated by a conservative approach. CONCLUSION: Frozen section examination is a useful method for the management of small incidental masses of the testis.
abstract_ja: 目的：小さな偶発的精巣腫瘍の管理における凍結切片検査の有用性を明らかにすること。方法：1996〜2002年の期間に凍結切片検査を行った偶発的非触知性精巣腫瘍の全症例を後方視的に検討した。各症例について凍結切片と最終的な病理組織標本が利用可能で、再検討された。結果：病理部の資料から15例を抽出した。9例は不妊症で来院した患者の超音波検査で発見され、6例は精巣外傷または陰嚢痛のための超音波検査で偶発的に発見された。患者年齢は18〜43歳であった。腫瘍の大きさは4〜16 mmであった。凍結切片検査では、9例が良性病変「Leydig細胞結節」と判定され、4例で悪性と判定され、残る2例は判定不能であった。通常の顕微鏡検査で、9例のLeydig細胞腫瘍が確認された。悪性は4例で確認された（セミノーマ3例、奇形腫1例）。判定不能であった症例は良性のSertoli細胞腫瘍であった。良性病変は保存的に管理された。結論：凍結切片検査は、精巣の小さな偶発的腫瘤の管理に有用な方法である。
